candidates.why: When is_uni is true, _objname is a malloc'd buffer from bit_convert_TU (line 6168). Inside the j-loop, if o->supertype != DWG_SUPERTYPE_ENTITY, line 6200 frees _objname and continues. After the loop, line 6308-6309 frees _objname again unconditionally (is_uni) -> double free.

After _objname is freed at line 6200 (illegal-entity branch), the j-loop continues to the next entity. If that entity is a valid DWG_SUPERTYPE_ENTITY, _objname is used again in LOG_WARN/LOG_TRACE at lines 6242/6263/6282/6300 -> use-after-free of the freed buffer.
